Amelia / Chris — looping in Hannah (legal ops) and Laura (partnerships) to validate the sequencing diagram. Attached is the lightweight sequencing slide and a proposed runbook of handoffs. Key points: 

- Gate A (Technical acceptance): completion of pilot + verification of basic infra (access to VPC endpoint for private run). Target: 10 working days from pilot start.
- Gate B (Security evidence): Redwood provides SOC2 summary and encryption detail at start of Gate B. This is non-negotiable to unblock DPA review.
- Gate C (Legal sign-off): MSA redlines to be returned within 5 business days of submission for first pass; if comments exceed a small redline threshold we recommend a short canary signature process (Order Form signed, payment hold until MSA effective).

Proposed timeline (conservative): Pilot start Aug 20 → Technical acceptance Aug 30 → Security evidence delivered Aug 30 → MSA submission Aug 31 → Target signature window Sep 7–14.

Attachments: sequencing_slide.png (in Drive link), runbook_checklist.md (summary)

Rachel
